title: Autopilot hosts
description: The hosts that the client knows, by name, at ~/.config/autopilot/hosts.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/autopilot/hosts.json). autopilot hosts add, rm and default change it. It holds no secret.

default.description: Name of the host that a command acts on when there is no --host and no AUTOPILOT_HOST. It must be a host of this file.

hosts.description: The hosts by name. --host <name> or AUTOPILOT_HOST=<name> acts on a host of this file. A name has letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starts with a letter or a digit, and is not local.

target.description: SSH target of the host as ssh reads it (for example user@my-host, or a Host alias of ~/.ssh/config), or local for this machine.
